# A dependency that is not installed stops the build with its name in the
# message. The importer reads types and never follows an import for code, so
# nothing before this point has any reason to look for the package; the bundler
# is the first phase that needs the module to exist, and it says which one it
# could not find.
[!node] skip
env SNGL_CONSTEVAL_CACHE=$WORK/evalcache

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
stderr 'left-pad'
stderr 'lib/index.ts'

# Diagnosed before anything runs, so the message is about the missing package
# rather than about node's exit code.
! stderr 'exit status'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import lib "js:./lib"

const padded = lib.pad("x")

component main {
    text(value=padded)
}
-- lib/index.ts --
import leftPad from "left-pad";

/** @sngl-pure */
export function pad(s: string): string {
    return leftPad(s, 4);
}
